title: German-Style Hash Browns
description: A crispy and flavorful side dish inspired by German cuisine. Perfect for accompanying your favorite breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Soak the grated potatoes in cold water for 30 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a bowl, mix together the grated potatoes, hash, salt, and pepper.
Heat 1-2 tablespoons of oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the potato mixture to the pan and press it down with a spatula.
Cook for 3-4 minutes or until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the hash browns over and cook for another 3-4 minutes.
Transfer the hash browns to the oven and bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
